name: Bounded Relative Error Norm (BREN)
definition: A property of a reconstruction neural network $\Phi$ where the ratio of the L2 norm of the reconstruction error to the L2 norm of the ground truth is bounded by $(1-\sigma)$ with $0 < \sigma < 1$. It ensures the network output is close to the ground truth.
summary: BREN is a theoretical property ensuring reconstruction error remains bounded relative to ground truth, guaranteeing stability and convergence in iterative deep tomographic reconstruction.
